migrations.\n336\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n337\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n338\t\tif err != nil {\n339\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n340\t\t}\n341\t\n342\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n343\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n344\t\n345\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n346\t\t\tdb.Close()\n347\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n348\t\t}\n349\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n350\t\t\tdb.Close()\n351\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n352\t\t}\n353\t\n354\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n355\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n356\t\t\tdb.Close()\n357\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n358\t\t}\n359\t\treturn d, nil\n360\t}\n361\t\n362\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n363\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n364\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n365\t}\n366\t\n367\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n368\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n369\t\treturn d.db\n370\t}\n371\t\n372\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n373\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n374\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n375\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n376\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n377\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n378\t\t);`)\n379\t\tif err != nil {\n380\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n381\t\t}\n382\t\n383\t\tvar current int\n384\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n385\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n386\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n387\t\t}\n388\t\n389\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n390\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n391\t\t\tif version <= current {\n392\t\t\t\tcontinue\n393\t\t\t}\n394\t\n395\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n396\t\t\tif err != nil {\n397\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n398\t\t\t}\n399\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n400\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n401\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n402\t\t\t}\n403\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n404\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n405\t\t\t); err != nil {\n406\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n407\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n408\t\t\t}\n409\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n410\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n411\t\t\t}\n412\t\t}\n413\t\treturn nil\n414\t}\n415\t\n416\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n417\t\n418\t// GetGroup returns the group with the AND thread_id = ?`, chatID, threadID)\n\treturn scanSession(row)\n}\n\n// CreateSession inserts a new session record.\nfunc (d *DB) CreateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\tif s.CreatedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.CreatedAt = now\n\t}\n\tif s.LastActive.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.LastActive = now\n\t}\n\tif s.Status == \"\" {\n\t\ts.Status = \"active\"\n\t}\n\tif s.IconColor == 0 {\n\t\ts.IconColor = 7322096 // Default to light blue (0x6FB9F0)\n\t}\n\tif s.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\ts.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO sessions\n\t\t   (chat_id, thread_id, session_id, cwd, model, status, icon_color, created_at, last_active, message_count, pinned_message_id, total_cost_usd, summary, notification_mode, timeout_sec, topic_name)\n\t\t VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID, s.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t\tnullableString(s.TopicName),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// UpdateSession updates mutable fields on an existing session.\nfunc (d *DB) UpdateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions\n\t\t SET session_id    = ?,\n\t\t     cwd           = ?,\n\t\t     model         = ?,\n\t\t     status        = ?,\n\t\t     icon_color    = ?,\n\t\t     last_active   = ?,\n\t\t     message_count = ?,\n\t\t     pinned_message_id = ?,\n\t\t     total_cost_usd    = ?,\n\t\t     summary           = ?,\n\t\t     notification_mode = ?,\n\t\t     timeout_sec       = ?,\n\t\t     dispatcher_mode   = ?,\n\t\t     topic_name        = ?\n\t\t WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\ts.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t\ts.DispatcherMode,\n\t\tnullableString(s.TopicName),\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// SetSessionIconColor updates only the icon_color field for a session.\nfunc (d *DB) SetSessionIconColor(ctx context.Context, chatID, threadID int64, color int) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions SET icon_color = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\tnullableString(summary), chatID, threadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\ntype sessionScanner interface {\n\tScan(dest ...any) error\n}\n\nfunc scanSession(s sessionScanner) (*Session, error) {\n\tvar sess Session\n\tvar createdAt, lastActive string\n\terr := s.Scan(\n\t\t&sess.ChatID, &sess.ThreadID, &sess.SessionID, &sess.CWD,\n\t\t&sess.Model, &sess.Status, &createdAt, &lastActive, &sess.MessageCount, &sess.IconColor,\n\t\t&sess.PinnedMessageID, &sess.TotalCostUSD, &sess.Summary, &sess.NotificationMode, &sess.TimeoutSec,\n\t\t&sess.DispatcherMode,\n\t\t&sess.TopicName,\n\t)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsess.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, createdAt)\n\tsess.LastActive, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, lastActive)\n\tif sess.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\tsess.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\treturn &sess, *AllowedUser) error {\n\tif u.AddedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\tu.AddedAt = time.Now().UTC()\n\t}\n\tif u.Role == \"\" {\n\t\tu.Role = \"user\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO err\n}\n\n// DeleteAllowedUser removes a user from the allow list.\nfunc (d *DB) DeleteAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`DELETE FROM Note any unfinished work or open questions.\")\n\n\toutput, err := cmd.Output()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif exitErr, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {\n\t\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"claude exited %d: %s\", exitErr.ExitCode(), string(exitErr.Stderr))\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"run claude: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Parse JSON output\n\tvar out claudeOutput\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(output, &out); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"decode proxy health: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Format uptime from seconds\n\tuptime := fmt.Sprintf(\"%ds\", proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds)\n\tif proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds >= 3600 {\n\t\thours := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds / 3600\n\t\tmins := (proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds % 3600) / 60\n\t\tuptime = fmt.Sprintf(\"%dh%dm\", hours, mins)\n\t} else if proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds >= 60 {\n\t\tmins := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds / 60\n\t\tsecs := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds % 60\n\t\tuptime = fmt.Sprintf(\"%dm%ds\", mins, secs)\n\t}\n\n\t// Build version string\n\tvar sb strings.Builder\n\t// Version string may already have \"v\" prefix from git describe\n\tver := h.bridgeVer\n\tif !strings.HasPrefix(ver, \"v\") {\n\t\tver = \"v\" + ver\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Bridge: %s (%s) built %s\\n\", ver, h.bridgeSHA, h.buildDate)\n\tif proxyHealth.Version != \"\" {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Proxy:  v%s (%s) uptime %s\\n\", proxyHealth.Version, proxyHealth.CommitSHA, uptime)\n\t} else {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Proxy:  (unknown version) uptime %s\\n\", uptime)\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Contract: %s\", contract.ContractVersion)\n\n\treturn strings.TrimRight(sb.String(), \"\\n\"), nil\n}\n\n// cmdUpdate handles /update [do] — checks for or applies updates (admin only).\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdUpdate(ctx context.Context, update contract.Update, args string) (string, error) {\n\tif h.updater == nil {\n\t\treturn \"Update functionality not enabled.\", nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Check for update requires admin access\n\tuserID := update.FromUser.ID\n\tisAdmin, err := h.db.IsUserAdmin(ctx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"check admin status: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !isAdmin {\n\t\treturn \"Permission denied.
